name: Dowry
overview: The Scriptures reveal that a dowry functioned as a formal provision in marriage arrangements, as seen in Exodus where a man who entices a virgin must endow her as his wife or compensate her father if refused. The book of Ruth further illustrates the concept through the redemption of land and marriage rights, emphasizing the responsibility to preserve family inheritance and honor the deceased by marrying the widow. These passages highlight the dowry as both a social and legal mechanism designed to protect the rights and legacy of families within the covenant community.
